hardRules.noOddNumbers: All spacing, font sizes, border radius, padding, margins, gaps must be even numbers
hardRules.noHardcodedHex: Every color must come from a variable, no exceptions
hardRules.noHardcodedFonts: Every font must reference the font variable
hardRules.iconsStrokeOnly: All icons use strokes, never fills. Bind stroke on VECTOR child, not frame wrapper
hardRules.noFixedHeight: Never hardcode height on components, use auto-layout with counterAxisSizingMode AUTO
hardRules.neverBuildInDrafts: Never create the Figma file in Drafts. A Drafts file cannot subscribe to the zcat team library, so component imports fail or detach. create_new_file defaults to Drafts: passing planKey alone is not enough, projectId is required. Verify with get_libraries that the zcat library is subscribed before building.
hardRules.correctLibraryOnly: Two libraries are accepted. The PRIMARY source (default) is ZCat-AI Understandable (file ugOZk4O0g6XpviEBSN24mF, key lk-6b302ab265d1e80fb5a2a876b2f9ecef1c2795c5fa5e168b3dadaaf3ab1aab4fbf0dab1bd19e7010bf498e184a6bd6ebb5c8b1e1bf780bb4d8db2a6267a82b5f). The LEGACY fallback (user-selectable) is ZCatalyst Design System (file dwQLnT4eJ3zCaOwhk7JXIn, key lk-ae83192f7b7305d9600785756ca9770312ad96826287c5b416a5e9f38c0b8c858632b716ed0e326c887e942ac3951557de60da44a53fc44693483ad0dd1dcd5f). Match on KEY, never on name. Default to the primary; only use legacy if the user explicitly selects it. No other library is acceptable — especially '2.0 Components', which is the old superseded library. Always pass the selected library key as includeLibraryKeys on every search_design_system call.
hardRules.sameSizeInGroup: When buttons, dropdowns, and text boxes appear together in the same visual group (action bar, form row, filter bar, modal footer), they MUST all use the same Size variant. Never mix sizes within a group.
hardRules.detachWhitelist: Only detach Layout, Accordion, Accordion Bordered, Dropdown Menu, Card BG, Container Header, and Sidebar List Panel — for content insertion, never for restyling. For any other component, ask the user before detaching.
hardRules.screenshotsAreReference: Screenshots and existing designs provided by the user are reference only — for understanding patterns and layout intent. Never copy exact designs from them, and never use them as justification for detaching or manually recreating components that exist in zcat.
hardRules.manualFramesMustUseVariables: When building manual frames, dividers, section separators, or any non-component element: ALL fills/strokes MUST be bound to zcat color variables (color/bg/*, color/border/*, color/text/*) via figma.variables.setBoundVariableForPaint. ALL spacing (padding, gap, itemSpacing) MUST use values from the spacing scale (0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48, 56, 64, 80, 96, 128). ALL text MUST use one of the 19 defined text styles (Zoho Puvi for primary, Inter for secondary, Roboto Mono for code). Even numbers only. Minimum font size 10px. Never use raw hex colors or arbitrary spacing values on manual elements.

colors.description: 3-tier color token architecture: Primitives (raw hex, no modes) -> Themes (semantic, 4 modes) -> Components. Components NEVER reference Primitives directly.

typography.description: 19 text styles across 3 font families. All sizes even, minimum 10px. Font families switchable via variables.

fontFamilies.name: Roboto Mono
fontFamilies.usage: Code snippets, technical data, keyboard shortcuts

icons.description: 425 icon components, all stroke-only with colors bound to variables. Every component must use these icons via instance swap.

categories.name: Product icons (colored)
categories.description: Zoho product logos, brand colors preserved

sizes.context: Inline with Body/SM, Label/MD, small buttons

rules: Bind stroke on VECTOR child, not frame wrapper
Aspect ratio locked on all icon components

spacing.description: Token-driven spacing scale. All values even numbers.

elevation.description: 5 shadow effect styles for elevation hierarchy

componentKeyMap._description: Quick lookup: UI element → componentKey + import method. type=component_set → importComponentSetByKeyAsync (then .defaultVariant.createInstance). type=component → importComponentByKeyAsync (then .createInstance). status=manual → build with frames (use zcat color/spacing/text variables). Keys are from the PRIMARY source (ZCat-AI Understandable). Legacy keys are in legacySource.componentKeyMap.

Button.variants: Type (Split Button, Button, Icon Button, Nav Button), Variant (Fill, Grey, Outline, Ghost, Text), Size (Default, Large, Small, Extra Small), Color (Primary, Grey, Success, Warning, Danger), Content (Default, Icon Left, Icon Right, Icon Button), State (Default, Hover, Click, Focused, Disabled, Split Hover, Split Disable, Button Disable), Radius (Default, Round)

Gradient Button.variants: Same structure as Button but with gradient fill styles

Toggle Button.variants: Size (Small, Default), State (On, Off), Interaction (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled)

Radio.variants: Selected (Unselected, Selected), State (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled), Show Label (Yes/No), Show Description (Yes/No). 16×16px circle.

Checkbox.variants: Checked (Unchecked, Checked, Indeterminate), State (Default, Hover, Focused, Disabled), Show Label (Yes/No), Show Description (Yes/No). 16×16px box.

Link.variants: Size (sm, md, lg), State (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled), Icon Left (Yes/No), Icon Right (Yes/No)

Text Input.variants: Size (Default, Large, Small, Extra Small, Compact), State (Default, Hover, Active, Error, Disabled, Read Only), Has Label (Yes/No), Has Helper (Yes/No), Icon Left (Yes/No), Icon Right (Yes/No). Active state uses black border.

Double Field.variants: Two side-by-side input fields for related data (e.g., first/last name)

Select.variants: Size (Default, Large, Small, Extra Small, Compact), State (Default, Hover, Active, Error, Disabled, Read Only), Content (Placeholder, Selected, Multi, Comma), Has Label (Yes/No), Has Helper (Yes/No), Icon Left (Yes/No)

Dropdown Menu.variants: Menu item list. Detach to edit items. Set layoutPositioning = 'ABSOLUTE' if inside auto-layout parent.

Dropdown Ghost.variants: Size (Default, Small, Extra Small), State (Default, Hover, Active). Ghost-styled dropdown with subtle grey appearance. Use for inline filters and secondary selections where a full dropdown is too heavy.

Tag.variants: Color (Primary, Grey, Success, Warning, Danger, Info), Size (Default, Small), Has Remove (Yes/No), Has Icon Left (Yes/No)

Badge.variants: Style (Solid, Subtle), Color (Primary, Grey, Success, Warning, Danger, Info), Size (Default, Small), Content (Text, Dot, Count)

Avatar.variants: Size (Small 24px, Default 32px, Large 40px), Type (Image, Initials, Icon), Show Status (Yes/No). Circular shape. Status dot shows online/offline/busy state.

Tabs.variants: Tab items with active/inactive states. Use for primary and secondary navigation within pages.

Accordion.variants: Expandable/collapsible sections. Detach to insert custom content inside open panel.

Accordion Bordered.variants: Same as Accordion but with visible borders around each section. Use when sections need clear visual separation.

Breadcrumbs.variants: Navigation breadcrumb trail for hierarchical page structures

Table.variants: Type (Default, Compact). Includes header row, sortable columns, row hover states, and multi-select checkboxes. LEGACY — prefer Table AI for new builds.

Table AI.variants: Style (Stretch, Boxy), Size (Default), Columns (3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). Booleans: Show Checkbox, Show Threedot, Show Pagination. Instance Swap: Col 1-8 (swap to any column type). ZERO-DETACH — 99% of tables work via setProperties() alone.

columnTypes._description: Column types available for instance swap on Col 1-8. Keys are LOCAL to the design system file. When swapping columns via setProperties, use the column component's node ID (find by name on the Tables page).

_Table_Col_Text.use: Generic text — default for most data columns

_Table_Col_AvatarName.use: Avatar + name + subtitle — entity/resource name column

_Table_Col_Badge.use: Status badge — status, state, severity columns

_Table_Col_IconText.use: Icon + text — type/category with visual indicator

_Table_Col_Button.use: Ghost button — row-level actions (View, Edit, Connect)

Attention Box.variants: Type (Info, Success, Warning, Error, Neutral), Has Title (Yes/No), Has Action (Yes/No), Has Close (Yes/No), Size (Default, Compact)

Card BG.variants: Color (White, Grey, Bordered, Elevated). Themed surface container. Detach to add content inside.

Divider.variants: Direction (Horizontal, Vertical). Use for section separators and panel dividers.

Key Value Pair.variants: Label-value display for metadata and detail views

Sidemenu.variants: State (Expanded, Collapsed). Left sidebar navigation with grouped menu items.

Layout.variants: type=Default (with left sidebar, 1259px container), type=No Left Menu (no sidebar, 1489px container). Page-level shell with top bar, content header, and main content area.

Container Header.variants: Type (Feature Name, Search, Tab). Booleans: Info Icon, Badge, Description, Tabs, Link Box, Filter 1, Filter 2, Filter 3, Secondary Button, Outline Button, Primary Button. Toggle elements on/off. Detach for customization.

Search.variants: Size (Default, Large, Small, Extra Small, Compact), State (Default, Hover, Active, Filled, Disabled). Dedicated search input with search icon.

Input Group.variants: Type (Default, With Button, With Link). Combines input with contextual action. Use for copy-to-clipboard, password reveal, inline edit.

Link Box.variants: Size (Default, Large, Small, Extra Small), State (Default, Hover, Active, Error, Disabled). Clickable link input field.

Alerts.variants: Type (Success, Error, Warning, Info), Has Action (Yes/No), Has Close (Yes/No), Position (Top, Bottom). Toast notification component.

Date Picker.variants: Type (Single Date, Date Range). Calendar-based date selection.

Code Block.variants: Editor (editable code), Viewer (read-only code display). Syntax-highlighted code block with Roboto Mono font.

Loader.variants: Size (Extra Small 16px, Small 24px, Default 32px, Large 48px), Color (Default, Inverse, White). Spinning loader indicator. Use for loading states on buttons, sections, or full pages.

Popup.variants: Default, With Scroll, With Description, Only Word, With Note, With View More, With View More Expanded. Modal dialog component.

Sub Header.variants: Page sub-header with feature name, help link, tabs, and action buttons

Empty State.variants: Illustration + title + description + CTA button. Use for first-time empty pages.

General Details.variants: Pre-built detail view with key-value pairs layout

Full Page Popup Header.variants: Header bar for full-page modal overlays

Three Dot Menu.variants: Pre-built overflow menu trigger (three-dot icon button)

Product Tour.variants: Onboarding tooltip/popover for guided product tours

Container.notes: Build with frames + auto-layout. ALL fills must use zcat color variables, ALL spacing must use the spacing scale.

Stack.notes: Build with frames + auto-layout. Use zcat spacing tokens for gap.

Grid.notes: Build with frames + auto-layout. Use zcat spacing tokens.

Row.notes: Build with frames + auto-layout. Use zcat spacing tokens.

Column.notes: Build with frames + auto-layout. Use zcat spacing tokens.

Spacer.notes: Build as empty frame. Size must use spacing scale values.

Overlay.notes: Build as frame. Fill must use color/bg/overlay variable.

Spinner.notes: Use Loader component instead (now available as component_set in AI file)

Shimmer.notes: Not in zcat library, build manually. Use zcat color variables for fills.

Skeleton.notes: Not in zcat library, build manually. Use zcat color variables for fills.

Label.notes: Build as text layer. Must use one of the 19 zcat text styles (Zoho Puvi primary, Inter secondary, Roboto Mono code). Min 10px, even sizes only.

Helper Text.notes: Build as text layer. Must use zcat text styles and color/text/* variables.

Kbd.notes: Not in zcat library. Use zcat color/text variables for styling.

Password Input.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box. Check Text Input first.

Number Input.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box. Check Text Input first.

Textarea.notes: Not found as separate component. Build as resizable Text Box variant.

Image.notes: Build as frame with image fill. Use zcat radius tokens for corners.

Progress Bar.notes: Not in zcat library. Use zcat color variables (color/interactive/primary for fill, color/bg/sunken for track).

Progress Circle.notes: Not in zcat library. Use zcat color variables for arc fill and track.

Rating.notes: Not in zcat library. Use zcat color variables for star fills.

componentKeyMap._description: Original ZCatalyst Design System component keys. Use only when user explicitly selects legacy source.

components.name: Container
components.description: Max-width wrapper component used to constrain content width and center it on the page. Handles horizontal padding and max-width constraints.
whenToUse: Constraining page content to a max-width
Centering content horizontally on wide screens
whenNotToUse: For sidebar or panel content (use Stack/Column)

components.name: Stack
components.description: Generic auto-layout container that stacks children horizontally or vertically with configurable alignment and gap. The most fundamental layout building block after Container.
whenToUse: Grouping related elements with consistent spacing

components.name: Grid
components.description: Multi-column grid layout component. Distributes children into equal-width columns with configurable gap. Wraps content into rows automatically.
whenToUse: Card grids, product listings, image galleries

components.name: Row
components.description: Horizontal flex container with alignment options. Distributes children along the horizontal axis with configurable spacing. Supports space-between and space-around distribution.
whenToUse: Distributing items horizontally with equal spacing
whenNotToUse: When items need to wrap (use Grid)

components.name: Column
components.description: Vertical flex container with span property. Stacks children vertically with configurable alignment and gap. Stretch variant fills children to full width.
whenToUse: Stacking content vertically in a sidebar

components.name: Spacer
components.description: Fixed space element using spacing tokens. Insert between elements to create precise, token-driven gaps without margin hacks.
whenToUse: When auto-layout gap isn't enough (mixed spacing)
Creating visual breathing room between sections

tokens.fill: color/bg/brand-subtle (visible in design, transparent in code)

components.name: Divider
components.description: Line separator component. INTERNAL USE: consumed by the Stepper component. For general-purpose dividers in your designs, build a manual 1px frame with fill bound to color/border/default variable — do NOT import this Divider component.
whenToUse: Between list items or menu groups
components.buildNotes: DO NOT USE for general dividers — this component is scoped internally to Stepper. For horizontal dividers: create a Frame, set height=1, layoutSizingHorizontal=FILL, fill bound to color/border/default. For vertical dividers: create a Frame, set width=1, layoutSizingVertical=FILL, fill bound to color/border/default. Always bind the fill to a zcat border variable.

components.name: Aspect Ratio
components.description: Fixed ratio container for images, videos, and media. Clips content to maintain consistent proportions across different content sizes.
whenToUse: Image thumbnails in cards and grids

components.name: Overlay
components.description: Semi-transparent dark background layer behind modals, drawers, and dialogs. Dims underlying content to focus attention on foreground elements. Always dark regardless of theme mode.
whenToUse: Behind modals and dialogs to dim background
whenNotToUse: Without a foreground element on top

tokens.fill: color/bg/overlay (aliased to neutral/950 in ALL modes)

components.name: Spinner
components.description: DEPRECATED — use Loader component instead. Available as component_set in the AI-understandable library with Size (Extra Small 16px, Small 24px, Default 32px, Large 48px) and Color (Default, Inverse, White) variants.

components.name: Shimmer
components.description: Animated loading placeholder that mimics content shape. Uses gradient sweep animation in code. Static representation in Figma.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: Static loading placeholder that mimics content shape and layout. Unlike Shimmer, Skeleton has no animation. Use for content-first loading where animation would be distracting.
whenToUse: Form field placeholders during async load

components.name: Badge
components.description: Small status indicator label. Two types: Primary (solid fill) and Secondary (subtle). 8 color options. Size=Dot shows a small presence indicator without text.
whenToUse: Notification counts on nav items or icons
Status indicators on list items or cards
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. IMPORTANT: the variant properties are Type/Color/Size — not Style/Color/Size as some descriptions claim. Type=Primary is a solid badge, Type=Secondary is a subtle/outlined badge. Size=Dot is a dot-only indicator (no text). The 'Required' badge in table schemas uses Color=Danger, Size=Default.

components.name: Label
components.description: Form field label with optional required indicator, optional text hint, and info icon. Used above or beside input fields to identify their purpose.
whenToUse: Above form fields to identify inputs
Show required indicator for mandatory fields
Add info icon for fields needing explanation

components.name: Helper Text
components.description: Contextual text below form fields providing hints, validation feedback, or error messages. Color-coded by state with optional status icon.
whenToUse: Below form inputs for validation feedback
Show error messages on invalid input

components.name: Link
components.description: Navigational text element for in-page or external links. Always uses standard blue color regardless of theme (not brand color). Supports 5 interaction states and optional icons.
whenToUse: Navigation to other pages or sections
External links with trailing arrow icon
Inline links within body text paragraphs
whenNotToUse: For actions that change data (use Button)
For primary calls to action (use Button)

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Keyboard key indicator displaying shortcut keys. Uses Roboto Mono for consistent monospace rendering. Styled as a subtle raised key with border and bottom shadow.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Contextual popup providing additional information on hover or focus. Dark background with white text for high contrast. Supports optional heading, icon, and link.
whenNotToUse: For critical info users must see (use Alert)

components.name: Button
components.description: Primary action trigger. Component_set contains all button types: Default Button, Split Button, and Navigation Buttons. Each type supports Fill/Outline/Ghost variants, 4 sizes, and 4 colors. Content=Icon Button makes an icon-only button.
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. CRITICAL: the property named 'Type' selects the button KIND (Default Button, Split Button, Navigation Buttons). The property named 'Variant' selects the visual style (Fill, Outline, Ghost). Do NOT confuse them — setProperties({Type: 'Ghost'}) will THROW because Ghost is a Variant value, not a Type value. Content='Icon Button' makes an icon-only square button. Split Button and Navigation Buttons are Type values inside this same component_set, NOT separate components. setProperties() throws on ANY invalid property combo and prevents ALL properties from applying — always query valid combos first or set properties one at a time.

components.name: Split Button
components.description: DEPRECATED CONCEPT: Split Button is a Type value ('Split Button') inside the Buttons component_set, not a separate component. Use: importComponentSetByKeyAsync with the Buttons key → setProperties({Type: 'Split Button'}).

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: DEPRECATED CONCEPT: Icon-only buttons are a Content value ('Icon Button') inside the Buttons component_set, not a separate component. Use: importComponentSetByKeyAsync with the Buttons key → setProperties({Content: 'Icon Button'}).

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

whenNotToUse: When text label is needed (use Button)
When action is unclear without text

properties.name: State
properties.notes: For a three-dot/overflow trigger: use "Pressed" to represent the active/open state while its Dropdown Menu is shown — there is no separate "Active" value documented.

components.name: Nav Button
components.description: DEPRECATED CONCEPT: Navigation Buttons is a Type value ('Navigation Buttons') inside the Buttons component_set, not a separate component. Use: importComponentSetByKeyAsync with the Buttons key → setProperties({Type: 'Navigation Buttons'}).

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Buttons component set

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Single-line text field for capturing user input. 5 sizes matching button heights, 5 interaction states, optional leading/trailing icons. Composes Label and Helper Text.
whenToUse: Short text: names, emails, search queries, URLs
Prefix icons to indicate type (search, email)

components.name: Password Input
components.description: Password field with masked input and show/hide visibility toggle. Same sizing and state model as Text Input.

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box

whenNotToUse: Visible text that needs to stay visible
keyDifferences: Filled content shows dots instead of text
Lock icon as default left icon

components.name: Number Input
components.description: Numeric input field with two type options: Stepper (chevron up/down on right) and Button (minus/plus icon buttons flanking the field).

figma.notes: May be a variant inside Text Box

whenNotToUse: Large number entry (use Text Input with validation)

typeDetails.Stepper: Chevron-up/down stacked vertically on right. Icon sizes: XS/Small=10px, Medium/Default=12px, Large=14px.
typeDetails.Button: Minus icon button (left) + field + Plus icon button (right), using Icon Button Secondary Neutral (350:722). Text center-aligned.

components.name: Textarea
components.description: Multiline text input for longer-form content. 3 sizes with minimum heights, character count display, and same state model as other inputs.
whenNotToUse: Rich text editing (use rich text editor)
keyDifferences: Uses Zoho Puvi Regular (not Medium) for body text

components.name: Toggle Button
components.description: Binary on/off control. Pill-shaped track with circular thumb. 2 sizes, label hidden by default. Custom variable toggle-thumb-off handles dark mode thumb visibility.

components.name: Tag
components.description: Compact labels for categorization, filtering, and selections. Used standalone or composed inside Select/Dropdown for multi-select options.

components.name: Select
components.description: Dropdown selector for single or multi-select options. Uses same sizing and colors as Text Input. 4 content types: placeholder, single selected, multi-select chips with +3more, and comma-separated.

contentTypes.Placeholder: Select option text in placeholder color
contentTypes.Selected: Option selected in primary text, single value

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Binary or tri-state selection control. Supports unchecked, checked, and indeterminate states with optional label and description text. Single size (16x16 box).

components.name: Radio
components.description: Single selection control for mutually exclusive options. Circular indicator with white dot when selected, optional label and description text. Single size (16x16 ring).

components.name: Avatar
components.description: Circular user representation showing image placeholder, initials, or icon. 3 sizes with optional green status indicator for online presence.

components.name: Image
components.description: Aspect-ratio container for displaying images with loading placeholder, loaded, and error states. 3 ratios, 6px radius, clips content.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.description: Horizontal bar indicating task completion or loading state. Supports determinate (percentage fill) and indeterminate (animated sliding bar in code). 3 track heights, 4 colors.

components.name: Progress Circle
components.description: Circular progress indicator for task completion or loading. Uses stroke-based ring with arc progress. 3 sizes, optional center percentage label.

components.name: Rating
components.description: Star-based rating display for user reviews and feedback. 5 stars with filled/empty states. Interactive selection handled in code.

components.name: Accordion
components.description: Expandable/collapsible content sections with chevron rotation.
whenToUse: Grouping related content that can be shown/hidden
whenNotToUse: When all content should always be visible
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component. To show custom detail content inside an open panel: import normally, set the open/expanded variant, then detach ONLY that instance to edit its content frame. Never modify the padding, gaps, colors, or radius the component shipped with — those stay bound to the same zcat variables after detaching. Only the content payload inside changes. Three confirmed content shapes: (1) a table with its own mini action bar (search + button, then Table — the Stretch pattern scoped to this panel), (2) a single editable value with an Edit link and the value shown in a bordered/monospace box, (3) Key Value Pair rows stacked in a single column with an Edit link.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Tab bar for switching between content views. Primary tabs go in Sub Header, secondary tabs inside Container.
components.buildNotes: Primary tabs belong in Sub Header (page-level navigation). Secondary tabs go inside Container for section-level switching. Do not place both primary and secondary tabs at the same level. Import as component_set.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: Hierarchical navigation trail with separator icons.
whenToUse: Showing current location in navigation tree
components.buildNotes: Place above the page content area, typically at the top of Container. Gap below breadcrumbs to content: 12-16px.

components.name: Table
components.description: Data table with sortable columns, row selection, and configurable cells. Stretch variant for full-width list pages, Boxy variant for bordered-cell detail views.
whenToUse: Displaying structured data with multiple columns
Stretch: full-width list pages (deployments, functions, rules)
Boxy: bordered-cell detail tables (indexed columns, schema views)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. DETACH WHITELIST — Table MUST be detached to customize columns. FIRST PREFERENCE: ALWAYS use the Table component — it has 11 built-in column types that cover most schemas. COLUMN TYPES: Avatar & Name (icon+text+subtitle), Description (text), Id (short text), Status/Badge (colored badge), Region/Text (plain text), Storage/Metric (fraction text like '41/100 GB'), Number (numeric), Date (timestamp), Checkbox (selection), Threedot (actions menu), Sort header (sortable). WORKFLOW: (1) Import and detach. (2) Map wireframe columns to built-in column types. (3) Hide unused columns (.visible=false). (4) Relabel header and cell text. (5) Set col.minWidth=null on each visible column. (6) Hide avatars from non-Name columns. KNOWN ISSUES: (1) Every column frame has minWidth=250 locked — set col.minWidth=null. (2) Cell templates include avatar by default — hide for non-Name columns. (3) Hiding columns changes child count — re-query after visibility changes. FOR MANUAL BUILD (LAST RESORT ONLY): if the schema is fundamentally different from all column types above (e.g., permissions matrix, column-definition table), ASK the user before choosing manual build. Table frame and rows must use layoutSizingHorizontal=FILL. Always pair with Pagination below (gap 12-16px).

components.name: Table AI
components.description: Zero-detach data table with 10 swappable column types, configurable column count, and built-in pagination. Preferred over legacy Table for all new builds.
whenToUse: ANY table in a Catalyst screen — this is the default table component
Stretch style: full-width list pages without visible card border
Boxy style: bordered card table with 6px corner radius
whenNotToUse: Simple key-value data (use Key Value Pair or General Details)
More than 8 data columns (use legacy Table with detach)
Highly custom cell layouts not covered by the 10 column types

properties.name: Style
properties.notes: Stretch: no card border, flat edges. Boxy: 6px radius card with 1px border, clipsContent.

properties.name: Columns
properties.notes: Number of data columns. Checkbox and Threedot are separate (controlled by booleans).

properties.name: Show Checkbox
properties.notes: Row selection checkbox column on the left edge (44px fixed width)

properties.name: Show Threedot
properties.notes: Three-dot overflow menu column on the right edge (44px fixed width)

properties.name: Show Pagination
properties.notes: Pagination row below the table. Hide for tables without pagination.

properties.name: Col 1
properties.notes: First data column — defaults to Avatar+Name. Swap to any _Table_Col_* component.

properties.name: Col 2
properties.notes: Second data column — defaults to Badge/Status. Swap to any _Table_Col_* component.

properties.name: Col 3-8
properties.notes: Remaining data columns — default to generic Text. Swap to any _Table_Col_* component.

columnTypes.name: _Table_Col_Text
columnTypes.description: Generic text column for plain data

components.buildNotes: PREFERRED TABLE — use this instead of legacy Table for all new builds. ZERO-DETACH: configure entirely via setProperties(). WORKFLOW: (1) Import component_set. (2) Set Style (Stretch/Boxy), Columns count (3-8). (3) Toggle booleans: Show Checkbox, Show Threedot, Show Pagination. (4) Swap column types via instance swap properties (Col 1-8). (5) Update header and data cell text by traversing children. STRUCTURE: variant.children[0] = Table Frame (horizontal, contains all columns), variant.children[1] = Pagination. Inside Table Frame: children[0] = Checkbox col, children[1..N] = Col 1-N, children[last] = Threedot col. COLUMN SWAPPING: Each Col slot is an instance swap property. Find column type components by name on the Tables page (they are local/unpublished). TEXT EDITING: Header cells use Subtitle 2 style (12px SemiBold), data cells use Body 1 style (14px Regular), subtitles use Body 3 style (12px Regular). All text colors bound to TABLE/* variables. BOXY STYLE: Has 6px cornerRadius and 1px border on the variant wrapper with clipsContent=true. STRETCH STYLE: No border, no radius. PAGINATION: Bound to Show Pagination boolean. Uses the Pagination component internally.

components.name: Attention Box
components.description: Banner notification with status color, icon, and message. Used for warnings, info, success, and error alerts inline on the page.
components.buildNotes: Place at the top of the Container content area, above the main content. Use full width (layoutSizingHorizontal = FILL). Gap to next content section: 16px.

components.name: Card BG
components.description: Card background container with state variants. Use as a wrapper for content sections. Default state is a white card; Hover/Selected/Disabled are interactive states. This is NOT a color-themed card — all visual styling comes from the state, not a color property.
whenToUse: Content panels within a gray/sunken Container background
Grouped sections that need visual separation
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component — detach to insert custom content inside. IMPORTANT: the variant property is 'State' (Default/Hover/Selected/Disabled), NOT 'Color' (White/Grey/Bordered/Elevated) as older descriptions claim. setProperties({Color: 'White'}) will THROW. Use State=Default for standard white cards. For dashboard card grid pages, Container fill should use color/bg/sunken variable and each section wrapped in Card BG (State=Default). For side-by-side cards, wrap in a horizontal auto-layout frame with gap 16px and children using FILL width.

components.name: Dropdown Menu
components.description: Floating menu container with menu items, dividers, and submenus.
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component (Menu List). For a three-dot/overflow trigger: detach this instance to set its real menu items (add/remove/edit rows to match the actions actually needed) — never restyle the shell (padding, colors, radius stay bound to the same zcat variables). Swap each item icon to match its action semantically. When the trigger lives inside another auto-layout component (table row, card, Sub Header actions row), position this menu with layoutPositioning="ABSOLUTE", anchored below the trigger, so the parent auto-layout cannot resize/squash it.

components.name: Gradient Button
components.description: Button with gradient fill for premium/special CTA actions.
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Use sparingly — only for premium/promotional/AI-powered actions. Do not use as a replacement for standard Button Primary.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Multi-step process indicator with completed/active/pending states.
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Place at the top of the Container content area. Each step shows completed/active/pending state.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page navigation with prev/next buttons and page numbers.
whenNotToUse: Short lists that fit one page
components.buildNotes: Place below the Table with gap 12-16px. Use layoutSizingHorizontal = FILL to stretch across the container.

components.name: Key Value Pair
components.description: Key-value pairs display for detail views and info sections. Shows label on the left, value on the right.
whenToUse: Detail page info sections (General Details, overview pages)
Metadata display (Event Listener ID, Created on, Created by)
whenNotToUse: Tabular data with multiple columns (use Table)
components.buildNotes: Stack vertically in a section with gap 8-12px between rows. For detail views, group related KV pairs in a Card BG or section frame. See screenshots 07, 08, 24 for live examples.

components.name: Double Field
components.description: Two input fields side by side for related paired data entry.
whenNotToUse: Unrelated fields that happen to be adjacent
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Each half uses the same size variant as other form fields in the same group (same-size-in-group rule).

components.name: Popup
components.description: Default popup/dialog container for confirmations, forms, and alerts.
whenNotToUse: Complex multi-step flows (use Stepper in a page)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Internal padding 20-24px. Footer with action buttons (Primary + Secondary/Ghost) aligned right. Use with Popup Blur behind it for the backdrop overlay.

components.name: Empty State
components.description: Zero-data state with illustration, message, and CTA button.
components.buildNotes: Center within the Container. Illustration above, heading below, description text, then CTA Button. See screenshot 15 for live example. For inline empty states within a section (not full page), use a simpler text-only pattern — see screenshot 24 'In Progress' section.

components.name: Layout
components.description: Full Catalyst page layout component with ServiceMenu, Header, Sidemenu, Sub Header, and Container. Two variants: Default (with left sidebar, 1259px container) and No Left Menu (no sidebar, 1489px container).
whenNotToUse: Full-page popups (use Full Page Popup Header)

properties.name: Container left Menu
properties.notes: Unpublished — available after next library publish

properties.name: Empty Sates
properties.notes: Unpublished — available after next library publish

components.buildNotes: Import as component_set (importComponentSetByKeyAsync → defaultVariant.createInstance). STEP 1 for every Catalyst screen — import Layout FIRST, then detach, then build inside Container. Default variant: has left sidebar (Sidemenu), Container width 1259px. No Left Menu variant: no sidebar, Container width 1489px. NEVER manually assemble the layout from individual components (Header + Sidemenu + manual frames) — this is the #1 source of broken builds. NEVER modify the layout shell (Header, ServiceMenu, spacing, borders, backgrounds). All content goes inside Container. Toggle Show Sidemenu/Show Header/Show Sub Header booleans BEFORE detaching. See layout-info.md for full node tree and zone IDs.

components.name: Sidemenu
components.description: Side navigation menu component within the Layout. Shows grouped menu items for sub-feature navigation.
whenNotToUse: Pages without sub-feature navigation (use No Left Menu layout)
components.buildNotes: Part of the Layout component. Groups menu items under section headings (STORAGE, SECURITY & IDENTITY, TRIGGERS, etc.). Active item is highlighted. See screenshots 23, 24 for live examples with grouped sections.

components.name: Code Block
components.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with Roboto Mono font. Editor variant for editable code, Viewer variant for read-only display.
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set (importComponentSetByKeyAsync → defaultVariant.createInstance). Editor variant for editable code areas (ZCQL editor, script input). Viewer variant for read-only display (logs, code snippets). Uses Roboto Mono font — load it before setting text. See screenshot 12 for live example.

components.name: Container Header
components.description: Pre-built action bar for the top of Container. Configurable with title, search, tabs, filters, and action buttons via boolean toggles.
whenToUse: Top of Container in list/table pages
Action bar with search, filters, and buttons
Any page that needs title + actions at the top of the content area
whenNotToUse: Non-standard action bars with custom widgets not covered by the component's toggles
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component. Import as component_set (importComponentSetByKeyAsync → defaultVariant.createInstance). Type variant: Feature Name, Search, Tab. Boolean toggles (hidden by default except Primary Button): Info Icon, Badge, Description, Tabs, Link Box, Filter 1, Filter 2, Filter 3, Secondary Button, Outline Button, Primary Button. Prefer this over manually building action bars — toggle elements on/off via boolean properties. Detach only when a specific element is needed that doesn't exist as a boolean toggle.

components.name: Sidebar List Panel
components.description: Pre-built sidebar list panel with title, search, and grouped menu items. For detail views with a sidebar navigation list.
whenToUse: Detail views with sidebar list navigation (Data Store, Settings Collaborators)
Master-detail layouts where the left panel lists items
whenNotToUse: Main Catalyst sidebar (use Sidemenu within Layout)
Non-standard sidebars with cards, widgets, or custom content
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component. Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Detach to edit content: update title text, button text, heading texts, and menu item instances per section. Fixed width: 300px. Default: 3 sections (add/remove after detach). See screenshot 14, 19 for live examples.

components.name: General Details
components.description: Pre-built KV pair display block for detail/overview pages. Shows labeled information in a structured layout.
whenToUse: Detail page overview sections (Event Listener ID, Description, Created on)
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Contains pre-structured KV pair layout. See screenshot 24 General Details section for live example.

components.name: Header
components.description: Top header bar of the Catalyst layout. Contains project name, search, environment switcher, notifications, and user avatar. DO NOT MODIFY.
whenToUse: Part of Layout component — never import standalone
whenNotToUse: Standalone use — always use within Layout
components.buildNotes: DO NOT MODIFY. This is a fixed part of the Layout component. The Header is already included when you import Layout. Do not import it separately or modify its contents. Only update the project name text and environment indicator if needed.

components.name: Sub Header
components.description: Page title bar below the Header. Contains back arrow, page title, action buttons (Help, Primary, Secondary, Outline), tabs, and three-dot overflow menu.
whenToUse: Part of Layout component — configurable for page-level actions
components.buildNotes: Part of Layout component. Editable zone: set page title text, toggle action buttons. Page-level actions (Primary/Secondary button, three-dot overflow) and primary tabs go here FIRST — fall back to Container Header only when Sub Header placement isn't meaningful. The page title shows the entity name from the list view (dynamic user data, not a fixed heading style). See screenshot 24: 'CUSTOMEVENT' is the entity name.

components.name: ServiceMenu
components.description: 64px left navigation rail with service icons (Slate, Serverless, Signals, Cloud Scale, etc.). DO NOT MODIFY.
whenToUse: Part of Layout component — never import standalone
whenNotToUse: Standalone use — always use within Layout
components.buildNotes: DO NOT MODIFY. This is a fixed part of the Layout component. Icons and labels only are editable. 64px fixed width.

components.name: Search
components.description: Search input field with magnifying glass icon. Used in action bars, table filters, and standalone search areas.
whenNotToUse: Text input without search intent (use Text Input)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Often used inside Container Header (toggle Search type). Can also be placed standalone above a Table or inside a Sidebar List Panel. Set placeholder text to describe what's being searched (e.g., 'Search for a repository', 'Search Rule').

components.name: Input Group
components.description: Labeled input field with optional prefix/suffix elements (icons, buttons, text). For URL fields, copy-to-clipboard inputs, and prefixed/suffixed data entry.
whenToUse: URL/endpoint display with copy button (Produce URL in screenshot 24)
Inputs with suffix actions (copy, clear, toggle visibility)
whenNotToUse: Plain text input without prefix/suffix (use Text Input)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. See screenshot 05 (SmartBrowz copy URL) and screenshot 24 (Produce URL with copy icon) for live examples.

components.name: File Upload
components.description: File upload input with dropzone or button trigger for selecting files.
whenToUse: File selection and upload (build artifacts, images, documents)
whenNotToUse: Text/data input (use Text Input or Textarea)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. See screenshot 22 (Slate landing - Deploy By Direct Upload) for live example with 'Select File' button variant.

components.name: Date Picker
components.description: Date selection input with calendar popup for choosing dates.
whenNotToUse: Plain text date display (use Key Value Pair)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Use the same Size variant as other form fields in the same group (same-size-in-group rule).

components.name: Dropdown Ghost
components.description: Ghost-styled dropdown trigger button. Transparent background, minimal visual weight, used for secondary selection controls.
whenToUse: Secondary dropdowns in action bars or toolbars
Filter dropdowns with minimal visual weight
Inline selection that should not look like a form field
whenNotToUse: Primary form field selection (use Select/Drop down)
When the dropdown needs a visible border (use Select)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Ghost style has transparent background — use when the dropdown sits inside a Container Header or action bar where a bordered Select would look too heavy.

components.name: Accordion Bordered
components.description: Bordered variant of accordion with visible border around each section. Used when accordion sections need visual separation.
whenToUse: Accordion sections that need clear visual boundaries
Configuration pages with distinct collapsible sections
When accordion items are spaced apart (not stacked flush)
components.buildNotes: Detach whitelist component. Import as component_set. Same detach rules as Accordion — detach to edit content inside, never restyle the shell. The border, padding, and radius stay bound to zcat variables after detaching.

components.name: Link Box
components.description: Clickable link container component. A styled box that acts as a navigation link.
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Also available as a toggle in Container Header (Link Box boolean).

components.name: Alerts
components.description: Toast/notification alert component for temporary feedback messages. Appears briefly to confirm actions or show errors.
whenToUse: Temporary success/error/warning feedback after an action
Toast notifications (save confirmed, item deleted, etc.)
whenNotToUse: Confirmation dialogs requiring user action (use Popup)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Typically positioned at top-right or bottom-center of the viewport. NOT the same as Attention Box — Alerts are temporary/toast-style, Attention Box is persistent/inline.

components.name: Loader
components.description: Loading spinner/indicator for async operations. Replaces the deprecated Spinner component.
whenNotToUse: Progress with known percentage (use Progress Bar/Circle)
components.buildNotes: Import as component_set. Replaces the deprecated Spinner component. Use Shimmer or Skeleton for content placeholders instead.

components.name: Popup Blur
components.description: Bare backdrop rectangle for popup overlays. This is NOT a dialog — it is just the dimming/blur layer that goes behind a Popup dialog instance. It has no internal structure, no header, no buttons.
whenToUse: Behind any Popup or dialog to dim the background
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). ALWAYS use this for popup overlays — never create a manual frame with hardcoded black/opacity. Place as a sibling BEFORE the Popup instance in the layer order. Set width and height to match the full page frame (1582×860). The component handles the blur effect and darkened background automatically.

components.name: Popup - Success
components.description: Success confirmation dialog with success icon, message, and action buttons.
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Use with Popup Blur behind it.

components.name: Popup - Error
components.description: Error dialog with error icon, message, and action buttons.
whenToUse: Showing critical errors that need user acknowledgment
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Use with Popup Blur behind it.

components.name: Popup - Confirm Cluster
components.description: Destructive action confirmation dialog. Requires user to type a confirmation phrase before proceeding.
whenToUse: Destructive actions (delete project, remove user, drop table)
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Use with Popup Blur. Contains a text input where user must type the confirmation phrase (e.g., project name) before the Danger button enables.

components.name: Popup - Provisioning
components.description: Provisioning/loading state dialog shown during long-running operations like deployment or resource creation.
whenToUse: Long-running server operations (provisioning, deploying, creating resources)
Operations where user must wait and cannot interact
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Use with Popup Blur. Shows a loading animation/progress with a message about what's being provisioned.

components.name: Full Page Popup Header
components.description: Header bar for full-page popup overlays. Contains title, close button, and optional action buttons.
whenToUse: Flows that need their own header separate from the main Layout
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). See screenshots 04, 16, 18, 19, 20 for live examples of full-page popup patterns. The header sits at the top of the popup overlay, with content below it.

components.name: Table Multi Select
components.description: Multi-select action bar that appears when multiple table rows are selected. Shows selected count and bulk action buttons.
whenToUse: Table row multi-selection with bulk actions (delete selected, export selected)
When users need to act on multiple items at once
whenNotToUse: Single-row actions (use inline buttons or Three Dot Menu)
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Appears above or overlays the table header when rows are selected. Shows count ('3 selected') and bulk action buttons.

components.name: Three Dot Menu
components.description: Three-dot overflow menu trigger button (vertical ellipsis). Opens a Dropdown Menu with additional actions.
whenToUse: Overflow actions in Sub Header (page-level more options)
whenNotToUse: When all actions can fit as visible buttons
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Pair with a Dropdown Menu component positioned absolutely below it. See decision-rules.md 'Building an Overflow (Three-Dot) Action Menu' for the full build pattern.

components.name: Product Tour
components.description: Onboarding tour tooltip/spotlight component for guiding users through features step by step.
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Typically overlaid on top of the target UI element with a spotlight/highlight effect.

components.name: Carousal
components.description: Image/content carousel slider for cycling through multiple items.
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Note: component name is 'Carousal' (spelling as in Figma, not 'Carousel').

components.name: Timeline
components.description: Vertical timeline for displaying chronological events or history.
components.buildNotes: Import as component (importComponentByKeyAsync → createInstance). Vertical layout with timeline markers and event descriptions.
